entries.name: Glass.aiff
entries.role: Selectable alert sound (Settings > Sound > Alert Sound)
entries.note: BifrOSt has its own synthesised alert set (Bell, Chime, Pulse, Tick); its Chime tone covers this alert's role. The Apple tone itself is not reproduced; reference asset via bifrost-ref (personal-use install; falls back to BifrOSt default)
entries.ready_note: The SDK system sound layer lists this alert name and plays a BifrOSt synthesised tone (not the original recording) when no reference file is installed.
